name: Latin (Advanced Language Study)
description: Certificate of Advanced Language Study in Latin offered by the Classics Department to non-majors. A certificate adviser, typically the DUS, advises students on the certification process. The certificate is listed on the student transcript once certified.
notes: Letter grade B or above required in all courses
Declare candidacy on Yale Hub as early as possible, no later than January 15 or September 15 of final semester
With adviser approval, one course such as an independent study (graded pass/fail), graduate seminar, or advanced seminar may count
One LxC course taught in English may count if it includes a weekly discussion section conducted entirely in Latin (minimum three students; course designated LxC)
Up to two study-abroad credits taught in Latin may be substituted with adviser approval

policy.sourceNote: All courses must be taken for a letter grade, and students must achieve a grade of B or above.

requirements.name: Courses beyond L4
requirements.description: Four courses in Latin beyond the L4 level (i.e., four L5 courses; 3000- or 4000-level Latin courses).
